entities.name: Zipper
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Gideon Sundback's "hookless fastener" replaced buttons, hooks, and laces. The military adopted zippers for flying suits and boots. By the 1930s, zippers appeared on civilian clothing. The name came from B.F. Goodrich.
